pairs.title: Egyptian pound in US dollars
pairs.description: How many US dollars E£100 buys. A rising number means a stronger Egyptian pound. Starts in 1991, with the unified exchange rate of 1991; earlier official rates were fixed, not market rates.
pairs.source: World Bank series PA.NUS.FCRF · official exchange rate, annual average, shown as 100 ÷ the published EGP per US$.
